title: Tracecat 1.0.0
body_markdown:
## Breaking changes


- feat(api)!: Require an entitlement for additional workspaces ([#3462](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3462) )
- security(deps)!: Update runtime dependencies ([#3471](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3471) )
- security(agents)!: Block SSRF in MCP and custom LLM requests ([#3499](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3499) )


## Security


- security: Fix polynomial regexes and dom xss ([#3479](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3479) )


## Case management


- feat(cases): Add filtered case aggregation ([#3419](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3419) )
- feat(cases): Aggregate cases by dropdowns and tags ([#3443](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3443) )
- feat(cases): Add case aggregation action ([#3444](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3444) )
- fix(ui+cases): Drop horizontal scroll in linked rows tables ([#3445](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3445) )
- fix(ui+cases): Thin hover scrollbars on linked rows grids ([#3446](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3446) )
- fix(cases): Return validation errors for internal attachment uploads ([#3460](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3460) )


## Tables


- feat(tables): Add table row aggregation action ([#3418](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3418) )


## Agents


- feat(agents): Grant tools declared by attached skills ([#3324](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3324) )
- feat(ui): Edit skill tool metadata with a picker ([#3325](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3325) )
- fix(agents): Classify LLM failures and diagnose read timeouts ([#3432](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3432) )
- fix(agents): Avoid fatal LLM errors during proxy shutdown ([#3439](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3439) )
- fix(agents+docs): Expose case and table aggregation actions ([#3450](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3450) )
- feat(agents): Open source presets, skills, and MCP catalog connectors ([#3461](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3461) )
- feat(agents): Add Ollama, vLLM, LiteLLM, OpenRouter built-in providers ([#3464](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3464) )
- docs(agents): Mark presets, skills, secrets/variables, and MCP catalog as open source ([#3465](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3465) )
- refactor(agents): Unify dashboard selection and guide model setup ([#3473](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3473) )
- fix(agents): Preserve original errors during runtime cleanup ([#3492](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3492) )


## Functions


- fix(functions): Extract escaped-dot defanged URLs ([#3491](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3491) )


## Integrations


- feat(integrations): Add Vercel Security firewall templates ([#3449](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3449) )
- fix(ui+integrations): Label MCP OAuth picker by provider grant type ([#3451](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3451) )
- fix(integrations): Let RunReveal MCP connect to a self-hosted server URL ([#3455](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3455) )
- fix(integrations): Bound registry discovery allocator arenas ([#3488](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3488) )
- docs(infra): Warn to back up compose file and Caddyfile on update ([#3494](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3494) )
- feat(integrations): Add AWS role chaining to boto3, S3, and DuckDB ([#3516](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3516) )


## Engine


- fix(engine): Raise executor payload limit default to 5 GiB ([#3441](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3441) )
- fix(engine): Preserve registry tool timeout attribution ([#3452](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3452) )
- fix(engine): Preserve cancellation while returning workflow results ([#3456](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3456) )
- feat(engine): Add unsafe knob to disable secret error withholding ([#3458](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3458) )
- fix(engine): Preserve registry tool cancellation ([#3486](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3486) )


## API


- fix(api): Skip denied Temporal search attribute registration ([#3426](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3426) )
- fix(api): Return classified webhook failures without platform alerts ([#3457](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3457) )


## User interface


- feat(ui): Add connected status filter and sort connected MCP servers first ([#3510](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3510) )


## Infrastructure


- infra: Drop platform tracing from Fargate ([#3403](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3403) )
- docs(infra): Add Docker Compose action throughput sizing guide ([#3511](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3511) )
- infra: Tune Compose executor concurrency ([#3513](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3513) )
- infra: Pull MinIO image from quay.io instead of Docker Hub ([#3517](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3517) )


## Observability


- fix(logging): Identify Temporal activity timeouts in Sentry ([#3421](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3421) )
- fix(logging): Capture platform failures at their source ([#3428](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3428) )
- fix(logging): Preserve registry discovery crash diagnostics ([#3459](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3459) )


## Documentation


- docs: Add feature GIF grid to README ([#3466](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3466) )
- docs: Refresh air-gapped model guidance ([#3493](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3493) )


## Dependencies


- build(deps): Patch js-yaml transitive dependencies ([#3477](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3477) )


## Other changes


- chore: Add Codex local environment for development ([#3478](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3478) )
- chore: Trim AGENTS.md and move path-specific rules into nested notes ([#3481](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3481) )
- chore: Run uv sync and pnpm install in parallel in Codex setup ([#3483](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3483) )


**Full changelog** :[1.0.0-beta.52...1.0.0](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/compare/1.0.0-beta.52...1.0.0)
